summary: Iteration 11: Tested 3 new features (Lobby search+category tabs, Daily Streak Wheel, Live Tournament). BACKEND: extended pytest suite to 91 tests (was 85); 6 new tests all pass covering wheel_status shape+401, wheel_spin fresh-user (amount>0, streak=1, balance increases by amount) + 400 cooldown on 2nd spin + status shows seconds_left>0, tournament_current anon/authed shape (prize_pool=5,000,000, name='OPERATION HIGH ROLLER', seconds_left<=86400, empty leaderboard, me=null for anon, me.rank=null/score=0 for new authed user), and tournament scoring hook (played coinflips on a fresh user until a win landed, then me.rank>=1 and me.score>0 on /tournament/current). Full regression: 91/91 pass, no 500s from add_tournament_score() hooks in slots/keno/coinflip. FRONTEND: /lobby renders search bar + 6 category tabs (all/dragons/fortune/military/egyptian/ocean) + 24 slot cards + LobbyHype + wheel/tournament live-ops cards. Clicking Dragons tab filters to EXACTLY 2 cards (lobby-slot-dragons_riches + lobby-slot-five_dragons) — verified. Typing 'zxqwerty12345' shows lobby-empty. Clicking lobby-wheel-card navigates to /wheel; wheel-spin-btn visible+clickable; after clicking, animation runs and wheel-result renders '+2,000'. On reload, wheel-timer visible and spin button is removed (cooldown state renders correctly). Balance in nav updated from 10,000 -> 12,000 confirming end-to-end integration. /tournament shows prize pool 5,000,000, resets-in countdown 23:52:44, YOUR POSITION card, and 3 leaderboard rows (from previous test users). No console errors — only benign AudioContext autoplay + Canvas2D willReadFrequently warnings.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: tournament-pool testid text_content returned '0' from Playwright evaluate (visual shows 5,000,000 correctly — likely wrapped in an animated number-tick component whose outer testid element only owns a spacer digit). If external scrapers/tests rely on innerText, consider placing data-testid on the container that includes the full number.

Carry-over: server.py is now ~2200 lines — the newly added wheel + tournament blocks (~200 lines total) push size further; still recommend extracting /api/wheel/* and /api/tournament/* into dedicated routers alongside kyc/cashier.
critical_code_review_comments: wheel_spin correctly increments balance via $inc, records a wheel_spin transaction, and persists last_wheel_spin_at + wheel_streak atomically in one update — no race between transaction and balance.
WHEEL_WEIGHTS heavily skew toward small segments (28+22+16 = 66% chance of <=2000, only 1/100 for 50000) — good economy; verified segments length=9 matches WHEEL_SEGMENTS.

Streak-continue logic: uses <48h since last spin to keep streak (i.e., yesterday's spin still counts); 24h cooldown means the earliest re-spin at 24h will always keep the streak alive — behavior matches product intent.
x2 multiplier fires when new_streak % 7 == 0 — correct 'every 7th day' semantics; wheel_status.next_multiplier previews it correctly.
_ensure_tournament uses a conditional update_one({status:'active'}, {$set:{status:'finalized'}}) claim to atomically transition finished tournaments — safe against concurrent finalize races.
add_tournament_score early-returns when amount<=0 — matches spec 'scoring only counts positive wins' and prevents negative scores from net-loss spins.
tournament_current excludes _id via projection {_id:0} — no ObjectId leak in leaderboard.
tournament_current works for both anon (user=None => me=None) and authed (returns me with rank/score) — correct optional-auth handling via resolve_user.
Lobby.jsx catOf falls back to 'Military' for unknown themes — safe default but any new theme should be added to THEME_CATEGORY to avoid misclassification.
Lobby search matches on name/tagline/theme (all lowercased) — good UX; empty state message correctly includes both query and category context.
